page.overview:
Who is Bakin?

Bakin (馬琴) is a minor character featured in Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan, and in The JOJOLands. He is the dog of famous Rohan. Bakin is also featured in the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan TV drama.

Bakin is a small puppy. He wears a collar that reads 'BAKIN, he is noted to look sad. but he does show happiness and other emotions

Being a dog, Bakin acts like one, he even shows happiness when pet by Kyoka Izumi.

Bakin is shown with Rohan watching rain fall. Later, when Rohan tries to give him food, he drops the container, breaking it. This means glass shards are everywhere. despite this, Bakin tries to eat the food, until Rohan stops him. They then go on a walk, where Rohan takes Bakin to the Mustu-kabe shrine. The duo check out the sacred special tree, finding a mirror. In it, they see a man.
